source_snapshot.procedure: Use `ipmitool sdr elist` to observe temperature change, `ipmitool sensor list` to compare warning/critical thresholds with SPEC, heat each sensor above warning and critical, and check SEL threshold events.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal temperature change, correct SDR/type/threshold settings, correct SEL at each threshold, correct fan-speed or shutdown behavior, and PASS for all TEMP_NVME_1 through TEMP_NVME_16.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek incorrectly assumes this source requires unspecified raw IPMI bytes and provides no runnable read or evidence plan, although the source explicitly names standard read commands; it still correctly notes missing platform expectations.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate dynamic reading, configured thresholds/SDR type, SEL assertion/deassertion and specified platform protection behavior for every TEMP_NVME_1 through TEMP_NVME_16 sensor under an approved bounded temperature stimulus.
original_test_intent.target: All sixteen named BMC NVMe temperature sensors, each mapped to one physical slot/device/controller and independently corroborated by the corresponding drive or platform temperature source where available.
original_test_intent.scope: Read current SDR/sensor/threshold data, raise and lower each target through the owner-defined non-critical/critical boundaries without changing thresholds, correlate exact SEL assert/deassert records and the threshold-specific fan/throttle/shutdown response, then prove cooldown and storage/host health.
original_test_intent.operation: Freeze the 16-sensor-to-slot/device map and specification, capture SDR/SEL/NVMe/host/fan/power baselines, obtain thermal/workload approval, apply only the vendor-qualified per-device or chamber/workload stimulus with continuous independent monitoring, record normal ramp and each approved threshold crossing/response, stop before unsafe limits, cool down, verify deassert/recovery and preserve all evidence.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One complete ramp/threshold/cooldown validation per TEMP_NVME_1 through TEMP_NVME_16. The 10-minute machine-time estimate does not authorize shortening hold/deassert timing or combining unmapped sensors.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required sensor tracks the mapped temperature normally, has the exact SDR type/units/thresholds/hysteresis, produces correct warning/critical SEL assertion and deassertion, triggers only the documented fan/throttle/shutdown protection at each boundary, and recovers without NVMe/media/namespace/host/BMC error.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Exact 16-sensor/slot/device/serial map; SDR records and sensor numbers/types/units/thresholds/hysteresis; stimulus method/profile and approvals; synchronized BMC reading plus NVMe health/temperature, fan/power/host telemetry; raw SEL IDs/event data/assert/deassert timestamps; protection response; cooldown; unchanged namespaces/data and final health.
ambiguities: No mapping from TEMP_NVME_1~16 to physical NVMe slots/devices is supplied.
The source does not define thresholds, hysteresis, sensor accuracy/tolerance, hold/cooldown, stimulus method or safe maximum.
`Correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed` does not state which response belongs to each threshold and could turn a telemetry check into an unplanned shutdown.
Empty slots, absent sensors and platforms with fewer installed drives have no applicability rule.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly defines the missing 16-sensor map, threshold/event/protection/stimulus/recovery contract and prohibits unsafe thermal work. It inherits DeepSeek's unsupported premise that vendor raw-IPMI bytes are canonical even though the source explicitly uses standard read-only `sdr elist` and `sensor list`, then turns provisionable platform inputs into automation BLOCKED.

applicable_history.decision: The historical record repeats DeepSeek's non-runnable raw-command placeholder and does not execute the source's explicit standard SDR/sensor reads.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. Standard read-only IPMI collection is available and the hybrid thermal workflow is technically feasible; exact mapping/spec/stimulus and human safety approval still prohibit heating or threshold crossing now.

execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform/thermal owner supplies sensor/threshold/event/protection specifications; the storage owner supplies drive map, data/endurance limits and NVMe health rules; the lab owner approves stimulus, monitoring, shutdown risk and recovery; workload owner supplies the maintenance window.

revision_candidate.test_name: NVMe Temperature Sensors 1–16 Threshold and SEL Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Validate normal tracking, SDR/threshold configuration, SEL assert/deassert and documented protection behavior for every TEMP_NVME_1–16 sensor under an approved bounded thermal stimulus.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact 16-slot NVMe/BMC/firmware recipe in an isolated thermal-capable lab with a signed sensor-device map, qualified stimulus, independent NVMe/BMC/fan/power monitoring, protected storage and recovery access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every TEMP_NVME_1 through TEMP_NVME_16 individually, including an explicit PASS/FAIL/NOT_APPLICABLE decision for each empty or unsupported slot under owner rules; no first-match or aggregate substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: 16-sensor/slot/device map; SDR sensor numbers/types/units/thresholds/hysteresis/tolerance; SEL event/assert/deassert map; safe stimulus/ramp/hold/cooldown; expected fan/throttle/shutdown per threshold; drive/data limits; approvals; monitoring/abort/SEL/recovery plan and tools.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve complete SDR/SEL/NVMe/host baselines; after final approval apply the qualified stimulus to one approved target/schedule; continuously capture BMC and independent temperature plus health/fan/power; record normal ramp and each allowed threshold/event/response; abort within signed limits; cool down and prove deassertion/recovery; repeat independently for every required sensor.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All sensors mapped and baselines plausible; standard read-only commands validated; thresholds/events/protection specified; drives/data protected; no conflicting workload; stimulus and monitoring calibrated; maintenance, shutdown risk, SEL capacity, abort/cooldown and recovery approved; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed per-sensor matrix; raw SDR and thresholds; synchronized BMC/independent/NVMe temperature and health traces; stimulus profile; warning/critical crossing and exact SEL assert/deassert raw records; fan/throttle/shutdown response; aborts; cooldown; unchanged storage and final system health for all 16.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform/BMC SDR and thermal-protection specification plus each qualified NVMe device's thermal/health limits; upstream ipmitool only defines collection mechanics.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never invent raw bytes, alter thresholds/fans, clear SEL, heat an unmapped drive, exceed safe maximum, perform unapproved shutdown, write protected data, omit targets or declare PASS from static readings alone.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC/thermal/storage/system owners approve mapping, stimulus, limits, protection response and potential shutdown. A human safety operator supervises each active stimulus and retains abort authority.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Stimulus setup, physical thermal control and shutdown disposition require an operator. Standard IPMI/NVMe telemetry collection, time correlation, threshold/SEL comparison and evidence packaging can be automated after approval.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On thermal overshoot, NVMe/media/controller error, unexpected shutdown/fan response, sensor divergence, SEL saturation or host/BMC loss, terminate stimulus, maximize only the approved cooling state, preserve evidence, avoid auto-retry/SEL clear, verify namespaces/data/drive health and quarantine the target until owner disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unmapped/implausible sensor, missing spec/approval/monitor/abort, unsafe baseline or workload, threshold/event mismatch, temperature divergence/overshoot, NVMe/media/controller/kernel error, unexpected protection action, SEL capacity loss, host/BMC instability or failed cooldown/deassert/recovery.

identified_defects: V2 incorrectly makes unspecified raw IPMI bytes a canonical blocker even though the source uses standard SDR/sensor read commands.
Missing maps/specs/stimulus approvals are provisionable readiness conditions, not permanent automation impossibility.
The source leaves the 16-target applicability and threshold-specific system response undefined.
reason_for_change: Separate safe standard IPMI collection and technically feasible hybrid validation from the currently missing platform-specific map/stimulus/approval; eliminate the invented raw-command prerequisite without weakening thermal, storage or shutdown controls.
